body.heading: Where in the world is Honduras?
paragraphs: Honduras is a country in Central America, which is part of North America.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Honduras is Tegucigalpa.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Honduras is Spanish.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Honduras is the Honduran lempira.

body.heading: How big is Honduras?
paragraphs: Honduras covers about 112,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about twice the size of Costa Rica.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Roatán sits on the world's second-largest barrier reef — families snorkel and dive with turtles in West Bay's glass-clear water.
Copán is famed for its carved stone stelae and a hieroglyphic stairway of over 2,000 glyphs — the longest Maya text known — with scarlet macaws flying free.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Honduras on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?

takeaway: Honduras in one breath: a country in Central America, capital Tegucigalpa, where people speak Spanish and pay with the Honduran lempira.
